summary.name: FolderForge
summary.one_liner: A macOS app for restyling Finder folder icons with reusable styles and preview-first, rule-based bulk changes done locally.
use_cases: Color-code project and media folders in the Finder sidebar
Apply the same folder look across several Macs
Bulk-style folders by rules such as project markers or file types
Add emoji or SF Symbol labels to folders
Revert folder icons to their originals
summary.what_it_does: FolderForge lets you add folders from a picker, pasted path, Finder selection, or a folder tree, with scope controls for depth and exclusions. You design a style with a folder color, artwork (PNG, JPG, SVG, ICNS), and a label such as an SF Symbol, emoji, or text, and can enable separate layers for back, paper, and front. Smart Style scans a chosen root, matches folders by name, relative path, marker file, or majority file type, and shows matches, unmatched folders, and conflicts before anything changes. Restore and undo options return folders to their original icons, and presets can be exported as plain files.
notable: Preview-first: shows exact folder scope and Smart Style matches before applying
Works locally with no account and no uploads; changes only folder Finder icons
Backs up pre-existing custom icons so they can be restored
Presets (.folderstyle) and rule sets (.folderrules) can be exported and shared
caveats: Custom Finder icons may not sync or appear consistently on other devices, including iCloud Drive folders
Smart Style scans are capped at 2,000 folders per run
Relative-path rules can change after a folder is moved or renamed
